about: R2-BRIDGE-STYLE ST4 (AC6): the explicit allow-list for make ui-theme-check STRICT=1. Each entry keeps its own colours for a reason the theme must not override.

reasons.res://ui/crew_chip.gd: D-80 crew identity colours: each crew member's chip colour and edge pattern (solid, striped, outline) is their identity; crew-console-test checks the palette's contrast and colour-vision separation on CrewPalette.PANEL.
reasons.res://ui/crew_console.gd: D-80 crew palette: the crew board's panels, stance bars and buttons are drawn in CrewPalette so the identity colours stay separable (crew-console-test AC6-AC12); it sits inside the console's HUDSheet panel and takes the theme's typefaces.
reasons.res://ui/crew_palette.gd: The crew palette itself (constants, no overrides).
